# Security policy

This repository contains a small public profile site and does not process user
accounts, form submissions or payment data.

After `moaaztaha.com` and its mailbox are live, report a security issue to
`security@moaaztaha.com`. The canonical contact policy is published at
`https://moaaztaha.com/.well-known/security.txt`.

Please do not include credentials, private client information or unnecessary
personal data in a report. Public GitHub issues are not an appropriate place
for an undisclosed vulnerability.
